commits.subject: feat(api): add portal credential management
commits.description: Staff can now create, inspect, rotate, and revoke Arbiter API credentials from the staff portal while the API remains authoritative for authorization, secret generation, and storage. New secrets appear once for immediate secure storage, and existing credentials show only safe status and audit details.

commits.subject: docs(api): add local Postman directory collection
commits.description: Developers now have an importable Postman collection and local environment template for exercising Arbiter health, readiness, and credential-authenticated member directory requests without embedding credentials or production data.
